name: 十二の気分から記録
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH13-0001「十二の気分から記録」.
Primary request: Redesign the exact Japanese mood-check-in component from image 1 in the official Lighthouse style. Render ONE component only, at a flat front-facing view, on a pure white canvas, not a device mockup or comparison board.
Input images: Image 1 is our saved Japanese FigCraft mock and is the authoritative content/layout reference. Image 2 is the original Calm source screenshot: use ONLY its twelve emoji expression artworks as original visual evidence. Image 3 is the owner-approved Lighthouse bus design, STYLE ONLY; borrow its white surfaces, subtle neutral borders, restrained downward shadow and precise rounded shapes, never its content, map or bus.
Composition: preserve the same 390x455 logical-pixel component proportions, three columns by four rows, all twelve choices in the same row-major order. Keep the heading two lines and centered. Reduce the large empty gap below the heading moderately for compact readability; preserve comfortable even row/column spacing, generous usable touch tiles and no clipping. Entire component visible with a modest white margin. White rounded enclosing card with a very fine neutral outline and soft downward shadow; twelve white rounded choice tiles with quiet neutral borders. Do not add a footer, button, subtitle, label, icon, selection or metrics.
Text verbatim: heading line 1「おはようございます。」heading line 2「いまの気分は？」.
Tile labels in row order:「うれしい」「わくわく」「感謝している」/「落ち着く」「満ち足りる」「疲れている」/「迷っている」「退屈」「そわそわ」/「いらいら」「張りつめる」「悲しい」.
Artwork invariants: the corresponding original expressions are happy smiling, excited tongue, grateful heart eyes; relaxed closed eyes, content smile, tired sleeping with tiny zzz; unsure frown, bored flat mouth, anxious clenched teeth; angry steaming nose, stressed squeezed eyes, sad frown. Preserve their original yellow expression artwork and associated small red/blue/white details. Remove only the dark square source-background remnants around each face. Do not redraw as generic outline icons or invent expressions.
Typography: established Japanese Meiryo. Heading Bold 20px/28px at logical scale, body Regular 14px/24px, letter spacing 0. Preserve exact text and wrapping, do not make tile labels bold. Main ink #1D1D1D. No Latin product copy other than the tiny original zzz artwork.
Color and state: pure white #FFFFFF canvas and surfaces. Source is an unselected twelve-choice state; NO selected tile or checkmark. No broad mint fill, green tile borders, blue button or random colorful icon containers. Retain expressive color ONLY in original emoji artwork. Forest-green gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E is the official action style but there is no active primary action in this component, so do not invent one to use the gradient. Neutral border #E4E7E7. Restrained elevation with no glow or glossy plastic.
Craft: clear weight hierarchy, aligned label baselines and centered faces; quiet consistent rounding. No extra branding, watermark or labels. This is an inspectable raster design candidate, not proof of application behavior or editability.
reviewNotes: 原画全体・12表情クロップ・日本語モック・承認済み参考を実見。元の色は表情の図像色で選択状態なし。白い未選択タイルと中立線を採用し、ミント面と暗い四角の残りを除去。生成結果を実見し12項目・順序・日本語・未選択状態・白面・見切れなしを確認。ただし表情が再描画され原画の細部が変化、見出しの厳密なMeiryoと太さも未証明。原画保持と見出しの修正が必要。所有者承認・ネイティブ編集・実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
